data_description.components: Whole components to update. They are determined anew on every run, so an add-on installed later is included automatically. Supervisor, Core and OS are always installed last; after a failure they are skipped, and at most one restart (Core or OS) is performed per run.
data_description.targets: Additionally individual update entities, e.g. a specific add-on or an ESPHome device. Select at least components or individual updates.

data_description.snooze_minutes: The alarm rings again after this time.
data_description.auto_stop_minutes: The alarm ends after this time if nobody reacts (per ring, also after snoozing).

new_integration_monitor.title: Integration monitor
new_integration_monitor.description: The monitor watches all integrations. You add rules for specific integrations (reload, disable, re-enable) afterwards via the gear icon (Reconfigure).

general.name: Monitoring
general.description: When an integration counts as faulty and what is reported.

data_description.grace_minutes: An integration must be faulty without interruption for this long before it is reported or handled. Short outages trigger nothing.
data_description.min_entities: “All entities unavailable” only applies when the integration has at least this many active entities. Avoids false alarms for integrations with a single entity.
data_description.check_minutes: In addition to the check at startup (after two minutes).
data_description.notify_all: Reports a fault of any integration (error state or all entities unavailable) via the ways selected below. Actions exist only through rules.
data_description.excluded: These integrations are not reported generally. Rules apply regardless.
data_description.name: Optional. Empty = “Integration monitor”. Enter only the name of the instance, e.g. “Office”; the function name is prepended automatically.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: How and with what the monitor reports.

data_description.mobile_targets: Devices with the Home Assistant companion app. Multiple devices possible; sent via the notify.mobile_app_… service of the device.

general.name: Rule
general.description: Name and switch of this rule.

data_description.entries: Only integrations selected here are handled by the rule.
data_description.on_error: Setup error, retry, migration error or unload failure.

data_description.action: “Disable” turns the integration off (entities and automations that use it then fail silently). Integrations you disabled yourself are never touched.
data_description.notify: Reports this fault via the ways in the settings, even if “Report all faults” is off.
data_description.presence_entity: Shows independently of the integration whether the device is back, e.g. a ping binary sensor, a router tracker or a smart plug. When it reports “on” or “home”, the integration is enabled.
data_description.reenable: Enables the integration the monitor disabled as soon as the presence entity reports “on” or “home”.
